summary: Cabin lookout in Kananaskis Country, built 1982 to replace the Pigeon lookout; sources disagree on which building was a POW-camp guard tower.

staffing.status: active in warm months; house is a lookout manager's private residence

access.note: The lookout house is a private residence. The official trail does not reach it; visitors use the Prairie View Trail and the picnic tables the manager keeps near the helipad.

visit.trail_note: Hike in on the Prairie View Trail from Barrier Dam Day Use Area; the official trail does not go to the lookout house.

events.note: Year of construction for the cabin in Alberta's wildfire lookout database (YEAR_CONSTRUCTED); the Friends' write-up and the directory give 1982 for the current lookout.
The original Pigeon building was moved from the lookout site to the university's field station.

corrections.why: No source read says the site is closed. The house is a private residence, but the official trail is open to hikers and the manager keeps picnic tables for visitors near the helipad.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Friends of Kananaskis Country ties the guard tower to the original Pigeon building; Explore Kananaskis ties Guard Tower #8 to the Fire Lookout House. Not resolved here; the story reports both.

sources.title: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta (WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT), FIRES database extract

notes_for_editor: The brief's access 'closed' is corrected to restricted (see corrections). The guard-tower conflict between Friends of Kananaskis Country and Explore Kananaskis is not resolved; the story reports both. Agency is not stated by any source read, so it is omitted, as for the other two towers. The layer copyright names the Wildfire Management Branch, Forestry Division, Alberta Sustainable Resource Development. The 'slowly being engulfed' state and the picnic-table detail come from a visit in 2016 and may be out of date. The Explore Kananaskis page is undated, so staffing as_of uses the 2016 visit. The brief's kind 'ground' matches the layer's 'Cabin' type. The manager is not named. The Canada Lookouts entry adds only the 1982 replacement line. One WebSearch call was used for this tower.
